desc: Button symbols per controller ($TTYD_PAD_TYPE fakes each controller's kind): player 1 an Xbox controller, 2P a PlayStation one (cross, circle, square, triangle shapes), 3P a Switch Pro (A at the right, B at the bottom), 4P a GameCube one (the game's own look). Shots: joined (each 'Joined!' note's Start in its own controller's look), homes (each home card's B in the head and A in the label line), controls (2P's and 3P's Controls pages: A, B, X, Z, L, Start as their controller prints them)
